## Read in data

Data must be exported in OUTLOOK format


This script reads a CSV file containing exported Google Contacts data. 
The file path provided points to a specific export dated "2024-12-14". 
Ensure the file exists at the specified relative path before running the script.

```{r read in google contacts export, message=FALSE}

x <- read_csv("../data/g-contacts_exports/2024-12-14_contacts.csv")




head(x)

```

```{r}
x %>%
  filter(is.na(`Home Address`))
```



Select columns of interest.

```{r}
# df <- 
#   x %>%
#   select(`First Name`, `Middle Name`, `Last Name`, `Home Street`, 
#           `Home City`, `Home State`, `Home Postal Code`) %>%
#   drop_na(`Home City`)

df <- 
  x %>%
  select(`First Name`, `Last Name`, `Home Street`,
          `Home City`, `Home State`, `Home Postal Code`) %>%
  drop_na(`Home City`)

head(df)
```

```{r}
# Create a simplified field for matching addresses
df <- df %>%
  mutate(num.st = word(`Home Street`, 1, 2)) %>%
  group_by(num.st) %>%
  summarise(
    `First Name` = if_else(n() > 1, paste(`First Name`, collapse = " & "), first(`First Name`)),
    `Last Name` = if_else(n_distinct(`Last Name`) > 1, 
                          paste(unique(`Last Name`), collapse = " & "), 
                          first(`Last Name`)),
    `Home Street` = first(`Home Street`),
    `Home City` = first(`Home City`),
    `Home State` = first(`Home State`),
    `Home Postal Code` = first(`Home Postal Code`)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(-num.st)

```

```{r}
# Write output for uploading to website
date <- Sys.Date() %>%
  as.Date(format = "%F")
write.csv(out, file = paste0("../data/script-outputs/", date, "_holiday_simplytoimpress.csv", sep = ""),
            row.names = FALSE, na = "")
```

Tweaks for Shutterfly

```{r}
noHome <- function(x) gsub("Home (.*)", "\\1", x)

shut <- 
  out %>%
  mutate("Display/Household Name (Smith Family)" = "",
         "Address Line 2" = "",
         "Country" = "", 
         "Email" = "") %>%
  rename_at(c("Home City", "Home State", "Home Postal Code"),
            noHome) %>%
  rename("Address Line 1" = "Home Street") %>%
  select("First Name", "Last Name", "Display/Household Name (Smith Family)", "Address Line 1", "Address Line 2", "City", "State", "Postal Code", "Country", "Email")

head(shut)
```

# Write Shutterfly

```{r}
write.csv(shut, file = paste0("../data/script-outputs/", date, "_holiday_shutterfly.csv", sep = ""),
            row.names = FALSE, na = "")
```

# Tweaks for Paper Culture

```{r}
pc <-  
  out %>%
    mutate("Recipient Name (enter 1 per line)" = paste(`First Name`, `Last Name`, sep = " "),
           USAddress1 = `Home Street`,	
           USAddress2 = NA,
           USCity = `Home City`,
           USState	= state.name[match(`Home State`, state.abb)],
           USZipCode = `Home Postal Code`) %>%
  select(`Recipient Name (enter 1 per line)`, 
         USAddress1, 
         USAddress2, 
         USCity, 
         USState, 
         USZipCode)
  
write.csv(pc, file = paste0("../data/script-outputs/", date, "_holiday_paperculture.csv", sep = ""),
            row.names = FALSE, na = "")
```
